## 📊 Thresholds (Not Rules)

> **Principle:** Thresholds guide while allowing natural variation. Context matters.

### Ranges and Guidelines
| Metric | Target Range | Flexibility | Notes |
|--------|--------------|-------------|-------|
| TTR | > 0.175 | ±0.02 | Lower OK for emphasis |
| Sentence Length | 20-24 words | ±5 words | Vary for rhythm |
| Complexity | 80/20 ratio | ±10% | Simpler for action |
| Paragraph Length | Mixed | N/A | Vary for pacing |
